_about: Hand labels for messages.json. These are judgment calls, written before tuning the prompt. intents = must be present; optional_intents = acceptable extras. route: automation | human | either. queue / priority: one value or a list of acceptable values. queue is checked only when the message goes to a human.

MSG-001.notes: Explicit, has order ID, read-only lookup. Tracking stalled 4 days, so the lookup opens a carrier trace.

MSG-002.notes: Explicit and polite. Automation sends a cancellation link the customer must confirm.
